reactors.context_query: SELECT COALESCE(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.total_stored_messages'), 0) as prev_total, COALESCE(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.health_score'), 100) as prev_score, "$when" as prev_when FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MessageStateAudit' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 1

transformation_expression.node_id: "$producer" in head ? string(head["$producer"]) : ("identity" in payload && "node_id" in payload.identity ? string(payload.identity.node_id) : 'unknown-node')
transformation_expression.node_role: "identity" in payload && "role" in payload.identity ? string(payload.identity.role) : ("role" in payload ? string(payload.role) : 'node')
transformation_expression.total_stored_messages: "storage" in payload && "message_total" in payload.storage ? int(payload.storage.message_total) : ("storage" in payload && "message_counts_by_type" in payload.storage ? size(dyn(payload.storage.message_counts_by_type)) : 0)
transformation_expression.health_score: int(ai.clamp(double(100 - ("storage" in payload && "message_counts_by_type" in payload.storage && dyn(payload.storage.message_counts_by_type).exists(m, m.total > 200) ? 30 : 0) - ("bpr_plugins" in payload && dyn(payload.bpr_plugins).exists(p, p.status == 'error') ? 25 : 0) - ("system_resources" in payload && "disk_pct" in payload.system_resources && double(payload.system_resources.disk_pct) > 85.0 ? 30 : 0)), 0.0, 100.0))
transformation_expression.irregularity_count: int(("storage" in payload && "message_counts_by_type" in payload.storage && dyn(payload.storage.message_counts_by_type).exists(m, m.total > 200) ? 1 : 0) + ("bpr_plugins" in payload && dyn(payload.bpr_plugins).exists(p, p.status == 'error') ? 1 : 0) + ("system_resources" in payload && "disk_pct" in payload.system_resources && double(payload.system_resources.disk_pct) > 85.0 ? 1 : 0))
transformation_expression.status_summary: string(("bpr_plugins" in payload && dyn(payload.bpr_plugins).exists(p, p.status == 'error') ? 'CRITICAL: Detected crashed BPR plugin. ' : '') + ("storage" in payload && "message_counts_by_type" in payload.storage && dyn(payload.storage.message_counts_by_type).exists(m, m.total > 200) ? 'WARNING: Message type accumulation threshold exceeded. Review retention policy. ' : '') + 'Storage audit complete for node ' + ("$producer" in head ? string(head["$producer"]) : 'node'))
transformation_expression.irregularities_detected: "bpr_plugins" in payload && dyn(payload.bpr_plugins).exists(p, p.status == 'error') ? [{'category': 'PLUGIN_CRASH_STALE', 'detail': 'BPR plugin error state detected on node', 'recommendation': 'Verify host controller permissions or restart plugin', 'severity': 'CRITICAL', 'type_name': 'BPR_PLUGIN'}] : []
